name: Tsugi no Giseisha o Oshirase Shimasu
original_name: 次の犠牲者をオシラセシマス
source:
When a bizarre chain mail about a serial killer becomes popular on the Internet, no one suspects that the murders are actually happening. This is the story of the people caught in this bizarre game.

(from [url=http://www.jbox.com/product/PSP3244]JBox[/url])

An adventure-mystery themed visual novel by Boost On and illustrated by Goto-P.
